name: Operational Technology Cybersecurity Masterplan 2024
description: Operational Technology Cybersecurity Masterplan 2024 (August 20, 2024). Strategic roadmap published by CSA Singapore to strengthen the cyber resilience of Critical Information Infrastructure (CII) and industrial control / operational technology (OT) systems.
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Cyber Security Agency of Singapore (csa.gov.sg) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for Cyber Security Agency of Singapore (csa.gov.sg).
